category_rules_range_ck.name: category_rules_range_ck
category_rules_range_ck.value: "category_rules"."min_amount" is null or "category_rules"."max_amount" is null or "category_rules"."min_amount" <= "category_rules"."max_amount"

goals_expenses_ck.name: goals_expenses_ck
goals_expenses_ck.value: ("goals"."expense_months" is null or "goals"."expense_months" between 1 and 60) and "goals"."expense_window" in (3, 6)

loan_events_payload_ck.name: loan_events_payload_ck

loans_amounts_ck.name: loans_amounts_ck
loans_amounts_ck.value: "loans"."principal" > 0 and "loans"."tracking_balance" > 0 and "loans"."tracking_balance" <= "loans"."principal" and ("loans"."payment_amount" is null or "loans"."payment_amount" > 0)

recurring_rules_transfer_ck.name: recurring_rules_transfer_ck
recurring_rules_transfer_ck.value: ("recurring_rules"."type" = 'transfer') = ("recurring_rules"."to_account_id" is not null) and ("recurring_rules"."to_account_id" is null or "recurring_rules"."to_account_id" <> "recurring_rules"."account_id")

transactions_loan_ck.name: transactions_loan_ck
transactions_loan_ck.value: ("transactions"."loan_id" is null and "transactions"."loan_due_date" is null and "transactions"."loan_part" is null and "transactions"."loan_payment_key" is null) or ("transactions"."loan_id" is not null and "transactions"."loan_due_date" is not null and "transactions"."loan_payment_key" is not null and "transactions"."loan_part" is not null and "transactions"."recurring_rule_id" is null and (("transactions"."loan_part" = 'interest' and "transactions"."type" = 'expense') or ("transactions"."loan_part" in ('principal', 'prepayment') and "transactions"."type" = 'transfer')))

transactions_transfer_ck.name: transactions_transfer_ck
transactions_transfer_ck.value: ("transactions"."type" = 'transfer') = ("transactions"."to_account_id" is not null) and ("transactions"."to_account_id" is null or "transactions"."to_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id")

transactions_occurrence_ck.name: transactions_occurrence_ck
transactions_occurrence_ck.value: ("transactions"."recurring_rule_id" is null) or ("transactions"."occurrence_date" is not null)
